title: Show playback buttons in panel representation
line: The Media Player widget on a panel now has previous, play/pause and next buttons next to the song title.
explanation: On a panel the Media Player widget only showed the album art, title and artist; pausing or skipping a track needed the popup (or a middle/back/forward mouse button). The compact representation had no buttons at all. The change adds previous, play/pause and next buttons after the title when the widget is on a horizontal or vertical panel and the player can be controlled; they reuse the popup's icons, texts and enabled rules. In a narrow vertical panel they are stacked, in a wide one they sit in a row under the title.

commits.message:
applets/mediacontroller: show playback buttons in the panel

When placed on a panel, the widget only showed the album art and title,
so pausing or skipping a track always needed the popup to be opened
first. It now also shows previous, play/pause and next buttons there.

BUG: 444083

patches.diff:
From 3068017c3d356f8e5d1495bd6117771ed5260924 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 22:55:58 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/mediacontroller: show playback buttons in the panel

When placed on a panel, the widget only showed the album art and title,
so pausing or skipping a track always needed the popup to be opened
first. It now also shows previous, play/pause and next buttons there.

BUG: 444083
---
 .../mediacontroller/CompactRepresentation.qml | 62 ++++++++++++++++++-
 1 file changed, 60 insertions(+), 2 deletions(-)

diff --git a/applets/mediacontroller/CompactRepresentation.qml b/applets/mediacontroller/CompactRepresentation.qml
index e828b21696..56977e4a91 100644
--- a/applets/mediacontroller/CompactRepresentation.qml
+++ b/applets/mediacontroller/CompactRepresentation.qml
@@ -14,7 +14,7 @@ import org.kde.plasma.plasmoid
 import org.kde.kirigami as Kirigami
 
 /**
- * [Album Art][Now Playing]
+ * [Album Art][Now Playing][Playback Controls]
  */
 Loader {
     id: compactRepresentation
@@ -40,7 +40,8 @@ Loader {
         }
     }
 
-    Layout.maximumWidth: layoutForm === CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.HorizontalPanel ? (Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 10 + compactRepresentation.height + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing) : -1
+    Layout.maximumWidth: layoutForm === CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.HorizontalPanel ? (Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 10 + compactRepresentation.height + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing
+        + (showControls ? compactRepresentation.height * 3 + Kirigami.Units.smallSpacing : 0)) : -1
 
     enum LayoutType {
         Tray,
@@ -68,6 +69,7 @@ Loader {
     readonly property bool isVertical: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Vertical
     readonly property bool inPanel: [PlasmaCore.Types.TopEdge, PlasmaCore.Types.RightEdge, PlasmaCore.Types.BottomEdge, PlasmaCore.Types.LeftEdge].includes(Plasmoid.location)
     readonly property bool inTray: parent.objectName === "org.kde.desktop-CompactApplet"
+    readonly property bool showControls: (layoutForm === CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.HorizontalPanel || layoutForm === CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.VerticalPanel) && root.canControl
 
     sourceComponent: inTray || root.track.length === 0 ? icon : playerRow
 
@@ -167,6 +169,7 @@ Loader {
             }
 
             ColumnLayout {
+                id: textColumn
                 Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignVCenter
                 visible: compactRepresentation.layoutForm !== CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.VerticalPanel && compactRepresentation.layoutForm !== CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.IconOnly
                     || (compactRepresentation.layoutForm === CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.VerticalPanel && compactRepresentation.parent.width >= Kirigami.Units.gridUnit * 5)
@@ -215,6 +218,61 @@ Loader {
                 }
             }
 
+            GridLayout {
+                id: controls
+
+                readonly property bool inRow: compactRepresentation.layoutForm !== CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.VerticalPanel || textColumn.visible
+                readonly property real buttonSize: {
+                    if (compactRepresentation.layoutForm !== CompactRepresentation.LayoutType.VerticalPanel) {
+                        return compactRepresentation.height;
+                    }
+                    return inRow ? Math.floor(compactRepresentation.width / 3) : compactRepresentation.width;
+                }
+                readonly property int iconSize: Kirigami.Units.iconSizes.roundedIconSize(buttonSize * 0.6)
+
+                Layout.alignment: Qt.AlignCenter
+                visible: compactRepresentation.showControls
+                flow: inRow ? GridLayout.LeftToRight : GridLayout.TopToBottom
+                rowSpacing: 0
+                columnSpacing: 0
+
+                PC3.ToolButton {
+                    Layout.preferredWidth: controls.buttonSize
+                    Layout.preferredHeight: controls.buttonSize
+                    enabled: root.canGoPrevious
+                    icon.name: LayoutMirroring.enabled ? "media-skip-forward" : "media-skip-backward"
+                    icon.width: controls.iconSize
+                    icon.height: controls.iconSize
+                    display: PC3.AbstractButton.IconOnly
+                    text: i18nc("Play previous track", "Previous Track")
+                    onClicked: root.previous()
+                }
+
+                PC3.ToolButton {
+                    Layout.preferredWidth: controls.buttonSize
+                    Layout.preferredHeight: controls.buttonSize
+                    enabled: root.isPlaying ? root.canPause : root.canPlay
+                    icon.name: root.isPlaying ? "media-playback-pause" : "media-playback-start"
+                    icon.width: controls.iconSize
+                    icon.height: controls.iconSize
+                    display: PC3.AbstractButton.IconOnly
+                    text: root.isPlaying ? i18nc("Pause playback", "Pause") : i18nc("Start playback", "Play")
+                    onClicked: root.togglePlaying()
+                }
+
+                PC3.ToolButton {
+                    Layout.preferredWidth: controls.buttonSize
+                    Layout.preferredHeight: controls.buttonSize
+                    enabled: root.canGoNext
+                    icon.name: LayoutMirroring.enabled ? "media-skip-backward" : "media-skip-forward"
+                    icon.width: controls.iconSize
+                    icon.height: controls.iconSize
+                    display: PC3.AbstractButton.IconOnly
+                    text: i18nc("Play next track", "Next Track")
+                    onClicked: root.next()
+                }
+            }
+
             Item {
                 visible: spacerItem.visible
                 Layout.fillHeight: true
--

media.caption: Master: the widget on the bottom panel shows only the cover and title
With the fix: previous (disabled on the first track), pause and next buttons after the title
Clicking Next, Pause, Previous and Play in the panel controls the player
Vertical panels: stacked buttons in a narrow panel, a row under the title in a wide one
